subject: Mutual Action Plan: IntegrataHealth — Integration delivery and owners
messages:
From: Claire Ho <claire@integratahealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Integrata <> Redwood — post-demo MAP draft

Hi Maya / team,

Thanks again for the demo today — it was helpful to see Redwood's streaming + tool-calling flow. As discussed, I've attached a very rough MAP to capture the integration milestones so we can sync on owners and timing. High level I captured the items we agreed:

- SDK integration (client-side) — Integrata engineering
- Server-side streaming & KV behavior — Redwood runtime checks
- Tool calling patterns (external system calls) — both teams to align on schema
- Structured outputs (JSON schema for clinical summaries) — Integrata product owns schema, Redwood to validate generation accuracy

A few asks for your side:
1) Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the primary owner for SDK questions and who will own the streaming runbook?
2) Any blocking dependencies we should call out (e.g., SOC2 evidence, dedicated capacity, firewall rules)?
3) Target close date: can we tentatively aim to have a working integration MVP by 2027-06-30, with a pilot run in July?

I've attached "Integrata_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf" — it's intentionally terse. If you want, we can turn this into a living spreadsheet with milestone owners and dates.

Proposed next steps:
- Redwood to return an updated MAP with assigned owners and concrete milestone dates by EOD Tuesday (5/4).
- Schedule a 30-min technical touch next week to walk streaming protocol choices.

Thanks,
Claire
Head of Integrations | IntegrataHealth
attachments: Integrata_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ho <claire@integratahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integrata <> Redwood — post-demo MAP draft

Claire — thanks for the clear notes and the draft. I've converted the key milestones into a lightweight MAP (attached) and assigned tentative owners on our side. Summary below; full details in MAP_v1.1.xlsx.

Summary of Redwood assignments (tentative):
- SDK integration questions / sample client: Dev Patel (dev@redwood.com) — owner for client-side examples, versioning guidance.
- Streaming runtime behavior & runbook: Maya Srinivasan (maya@redwood.com) — owner for routing/batching expectations and production SLOs.
- Tool-calling patterns & failover behavior: Dev + Maya (paired) — will propose a canonical request/response pattern.
- Structured outputs validation: Neha Kapoor (neha@redwood.com) — will own generation-level tests and schema validation harness.

Proposed milestone dates (draft):
- 2027-05-10: SDK sample + integration checklist delivered (owner: Dev)
- 2027-05-17: Streaming runbook + protocol choice (gRPC vs WS) agreed (owner: Maya)
- 2027-05-24: Tool-calling contract (example calls + error handling) (owner: Dev)
- 2027-06-14: Structured-output schema + validation tests (owner: Neha)
- 2027-06-30: Integration MVP ready for pilot

Dependencies noted (we add these in spreadsheet):
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence (Integrata requested sample logs)
- Network egress rules (Integrata firewall IPs)
- Decide on streaming protocol (gRPC preferred internally, WebSocket may be lighter for browser SDK)

I've attached MAP_v1.1.xlsx with a column for "accepted by Integrata" and a place to add Integrata owners / dates. Please review and either mark owners in the sheet or reply with changes.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a technical touch to align on streaming.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP_v1.1.xlsx
From: Mike Shore <mike@integratahealth.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Ho <claire@integratahealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integrata <> Redwood — post-demo MAP draft

On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 9:15 AM Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com> wrote:
> I've attached MAP_v1.1.xlsx with a column for "accepted by Integrata" and a place to add Integrata owners / dates. Please review and either mark owners in the sheet or reply with changes.

Thanks, Maya — quick technical notes from our side so you can slot them into the MAP:

- SDK: we'll be using a Node+React front-end and prefer a lightweight browser-friendly JS SDK. We need explicit guidance about token refresh rotation and a sample that supports streaming tokens.
- Streaming protocol: Integrata strongly prefers WebSocket for browser clients to avoid gRPC-web glue; however our backend services support gRPC. Can Redwood confirm latency/cost tradeoffs between your gRPC path vs WS proxy?
- Tool calling: when Redwood's model calls back to our APIs, we need a retry/backup plan for failures. Would Redwood surface an error envelope and request-id to help idempotency?
- Structured outputs: we'll provide a FHIR-lite JSON schema for clinical summaries — can Redwood run lightweight schema validation before returning to end users?

Also — a small ask: can you include an example of the KV/prefix caching behavior in the runbook? We want to understand cache warming for long-running sessions.

I'll add owners in the spreadsheet after we confirm the SDK sample date.

-Mike
Senior Engineer, Integrations | IntegrataHealth
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ho <claire@integratahealth.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integrata <> Redwood — post-demo MAP draft

Claire / team — quick update from Redwood ops & security side so dependencies are clear: 

- Security & compliance: we can share SOC2 Type II summary and sample audit logs; full evidence package requires an NDA addendum for integrator access (I can start that process).
- Dedicated capacity / throughput: if you expect sustained high TPS for streaming, we should scope a Dedicated pool; otherwise hosted can work for pilot.
- Firewall rules: please provide egress IPs and any static CIDR ranges; otherwise we'll supply our egress endpoints and recommend TLS+mutual auth if you prefer.

I've added an "Integration dependencies" note doc (integration-deps.md) to the drive linked in the MAP. Key action items I've added to MAP_v1.1.xlsx under Dependencies: SOC2 evidence request (owner: Neha), Network allowlist (owner: Integrata), Dedicated capacity decision (owner: Integrata + Redwood).

I'll coordinate the NDA addendum draft once Claire confirms.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Reliability | Redwood Inference
attachments: integration-deps.md
From: Claire Ho <claire@integratahealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integrata <> Redwood — post-demo MAP draft

Thanks everyone — this looks good. We accepted the items and I've populated Integrata owners in the spreadsheet (map_v1.1, column B):

- SDK sample: Mike Shore (owner) — will confirm sample by 2027-05-11
- Networking & firewall: Claire Ho (owner) — will provide allowlist by 2027-05-07
- Pilot evaluation criteria: Product (owner) — will confirm KPIs by 2027-06-10

We are comfortable with the target close date of 2027-06-30 for an MVP pilot. A few clarifications:
- We prefer WebSocket for browser SDK initially; we'll rely on Redwood's pref for backend gRPC for server-to-server flows.
- For tool-calling idempotency, yes, please include a request-id and error envelope — that will make retries safe for us.
- SOC2 evidence: we can sign the NDA addendum to get the package — please send the draft and we'll expedite.

Proposed cadence: 30-minute tech sync every Wednesday 10:00 AM PT starting 2027-05-12. If that works for Redwood, please send the recurring invite.

Maya — can you confirm you'll send the recurring invite and an updated MAP with final owner columns populated? If so, we'll mark this as "MAP reviewed" on our side and move to the first engineering sprint.

Thanks,
Claire
Head of Integrations | IntegrataHealth
